tagline: From Strategic Intent to Intelligent Execution
subtagline: Assess comprehensively. Identify the constraint. Architect the target. Build the capability. Transform systematically. Measure and evolve.
description: ZenAI Digital helps organisations assess enterprise AI transformation capability, identify constraints, design target architectures, build capability and turn AI ambition into sustainable execution.

founder.name: Dr Sunil Mysore Kempegowda
founder.summary: Research-led practitioner working across enterprise architecture, digital transformation, capability maturity and enterprise AI.

method.name: Architect
